player_prompt.intro:
A don hawre caka da {num_buttons} kofin: {buttons}. Kofin kowal e wada da rabawo Bernoulli da matsakaicin da ba'a sani ba; matsakaicin kofin e wada da bambancin.
Kowal kofin, so a ka taka, a ka samu lada da aka dawo daga rabawo din.
A ka da {num_turns} lokutan, kuma a kowal lokaci, a ka iya zaba kofin kowal, a ka samu lada.
Buri nka shine zaba kofin da hankali a kowal lokaci domin tattara bayanai game da rabawo din lada, wanda zai baka damar zaba kofin da lada matsakaicin da yafi a karshen {num_turns} lokutan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jaawal man jaabake be dabareji kuuɗe je ɗon nafo.

game_action.pressed: A yiɗɗa bouti {button} kadi e jottori reward ɗen {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: A ɗon heɓa ko a yiɗi ngam foondaago dabareji feere-feere e yi'ugo barka maɓɓe. Jooni waɗu jannde dow jeyeende suɓol ɓurɗum wooɗuki.

outcome.win: Koolaaɓe, a suɓi boton je ɗon nafo.
